description: This file contains utility functions and React hooks for managing user property fields in the Mattermost admin console, including fetching, creating, updating, deleting, and validating custom profile attribute fields.

methods.name: useUserPropertyFields
methods.description: React hook for managing user property fields, including fetching current fields, handling pending changes, validation, and operations like create, update, delete, and reorder.

methods.name: getIncrementedName
methods.description: Generates a unique name by appending a number if the desired name already exists in the collection.

methods.name: isCreatePending
methods.description: Checks if a user property field is pending creation (not yet created and not deleted).

methods.name: isDeletePending
methods.description: Checks if a user property field is pending deletion (created and marked for deletion).

methods.name: newPendingId
methods.description: Generates a new unique ID for a pending user property field.

methods.name: newPendingField
methods.description: Creates a new pending user property field object with default attributes and a unique ID.
